title: The coat on the hook
logline: The blue plaid on a hook by the garage door, from behind the empty coat — the sequence draws the back without the man in it. October 31; the page doesn't know it.

panels.composition: A blue plaid flannel shirt hanging from a hook by a garage door, seen from its back, the door's window dark, a dog's leash on the next hook.
